source_design_findings.finding: The production diff changes provider lookup plumbing only. Opacity, gamma, heat, ownership, reductions, underflow accounting, material updates, residuals, and conservation gates retain their arithmetic and ordering.

Each packet slot stores three channel values. Energy is compared using to_bits and a changed energy invalidates all channel entries. Both callers use matching HI/HeI/HeII channel order. The reference AtomicProvider is stateless and its production cross-section calculation is unchanged.

Each public implicit transaction creates a local cache. Source preflight and its inner transaction share the cache while packet energies and slot count remain aligned. Caches are not stored in continuous/adaptive state and cannot persist across public coarse/half-step transactions.

Only successful sigma values are stored. Validation remains ahead of provider evaluation and disabled channels skip lookup. Cache construction records energy bits without evaluating sigma. No production error-order regression was found.

Public signatures are unchanged and new cache interfaces are crate-private. Production changes are confined to igm_photo.rs and igm_step.rs; atomic_provider.rs changes are cfg(test)-only instrumentation.

non_blocking_gaps.finding: The count fixture covers one all-active packet. A multi-packet mixed-mask fixture would directly protect the general active-channel evaluation bound.
Fresh cache ownership across consecutive public transactions is structurally established but lacks a dedicated provider-count regression test.
The lazy-error test verifies the first failed lookup, but a repeated-failure assertion would directly protect the invariant that errors are never cached.
Equality assertions use Debug serialization. Explicit per-field to_bits comparisons would express the bitwise contract more directly; no current mismatch was found.

claim_limits: Corpus and persisted-output equality is not proof for every possible state.
The healthy history comparisons retain the pre-existing scale-1000 research profile on both sides; default scale-1 failure remains unchanged.
The 25.9% and 32.9% reductions are local process-CPU microbenchmark observations, not an end-to-end full-trajectory or universal speed claim.
No tolerance relaxation, arithmetic fix, merge, publication, or new scientific acceptance is established or authorized.
